# Which price earns the most?

> Free Gabor-Granger price analyzer. Paste the highest price each survey respondent would buy at and get the demand curve, the revenue-maximising price, the profit-maximising price for your unit cost, and bootstrap bands. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
